status_note: Draft consent copy pending T1.11. Not reviewed by Legal or Security. The five scopes follow BR-02.

scopes.data_covered: Your answers, the sample or file you choose, and any lab values you enter.
scopes.used_for: Running the safety check and the draft assessment in this session.
scopes.who_sees_it: Only this session. A reviewer sees it only if you also turn on clinician review.
scopes.if_off: You see general education and emergency guidance only. Nothing about your health is stored.

scopes.data_covered: Your draft result and the information it is based on.
scopes.used_for: Letting a reviewer at a mock facility check the draft. The review is simulated.
scopes.who_sees_it: A simulated reviewer account in this demo.
scopes.if_off: Nobody reviews the draft, and no next step that needs approval is shown.

scopes.data_covered: A short approved summary: a case code, the type of care, the reviewer's summary and its limits.
scopes.used_for: Sending a mock referral to an invented facility. Nothing reaches a real clinic.
scopes.who_sees_it: A mock facility account in this demo.
scopes.if_off: No referral is sent. A mock referral already sent is withdrawn.

scopes.used_for: Not used in this flow. Nothing is shared with a spouse or partner.
